# Runes

> Runes brings fungible assets into Bitcoin’s UTXO world with compact onchain messages, clear supply terms, and a lifecycle built for discovery.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/runes/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/runes/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/runes/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Etch: Create a rune identity with its symbol, divisibility, supply, and mint terms.
- Mint: Join an open mint while its published terms and window allow.
- Transfer: Move rune balances through compatible Bitcoin wallets and outputs.

## In plain language

- Runestones: Rune messages live in an OP_RETURN output marked for the protocol.
- Etchings: An etching establishes the rune and its supply personality.
- Mints: Mint activity follows the terms chosen when the rune was etched.
- Allocations: Edicts direct rune amounts to transaction outputs.

## User safety

Malformed Rune messages can become cenotaphs and burn rune balances. Use a compatible wallet, verify the destination and allocation, and never blind-sign a transaction.

## Community resources

- Explore Runes: https://docs.ordinals.com/runes.html
- Read the Runes protocol: https://docs.ordinals.com/runes/specification.html
